'''2009 2K Event Day 2 Hayes Hunter LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Hayes Hunter]] at [[2009 2K Event]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassithroneroom.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' HH
* '''Username:''' Hayes
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
